page_title: MOR 0-0 SPA (PEN: 3-0) | Morocco v Spain 06/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 121' That's it. The end of the match.
121' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) sends Unai Simon the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
121' Sergio Busquets (Spain) misses the penalty! He fired the ball towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulled off a tremendous diving save to deny him.
121' Penalty saved! Badr Benoun (Morocco) sends the penalty towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
121' Bono dives to the left side of the goal and brilliantly saves the penalty taken by Carlos Soler (Spain)!
121' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) scores from the penalty spot with a powerful shot that goes into the middle of the goal after the goalkeeper dives!
121' Pablo Sarabia (Spain) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
121' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Unai Simon no chance!
121' The match will be decided by a penalty shootout. Who will be the winner and who will be the loser?
120+4' The second period of extra time has not decided the winner of this match.
120+3' Pablo Sarabia (Spain) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.
120+2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pablo Sarabia (Spain). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

120+2' Pablo Sarabia (Spain) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Spain are awarded a corner kick.
120+1' Sergio Busquets (Spain) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
120' 3 additional min. will be played.
120' The resulting corner from Pablo Sarabia (Spain) comes to nothing.
120' Walid Regragui prepares a substitution. Azzedine Ounahi is replaced by Badr Benoun (Morocco).

120' Marcos Llorente (Spain) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Spain have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
118' Here comes a substitution. Pablo Sarabia (Spain) is brought on as a substitute for Nico Williams.
118' Nico Williams (Spain) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
117' Alvaro Morata (Spain) plays a through ball but overhits it.
115' Walid Cheddira (Morocco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
112' Romain Saiss (Morocco) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
111' Romain Saiss (Morocco) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
109' Sergio Busquets (Spain) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
106' Carlos Soler (Spain) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ansu Fati.
106' The second period of extra time has just started and both teams will probably play with a lot of cautiously as neither of them will want to risk losing the match by trying to win it.
105+2' The referee blows his whistle for the end of the first half in extra-time.
105+2' Carlos Soler (Spain) swings in a cross from the corner, but Bono reads it well and gathers the ball.
105' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
104' A fine pass finds Walid Cheddira (Morocco) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Unai Simon reacts superbly to deny him.
103' Wasted opportunity! Rodri (Spain) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
102' The foul by Ez Abde (Morocco) was seen by Fernando Rapallini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
101' Ansu Fati (Spain) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
100' Alejandro Balde (Spain) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Good work from Spain as they win a corner.
100' Alvaro Morata (Spain) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
98' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Alejandro Balde (Spain) replaces Jordi Alba.
98' That will be all from Dani Olmo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ansu Fati (Spain).
97' Nico Williams (Spain) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
95' Walid Cheddira (Morocco) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
93' Rodri (Spain) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
91' Full time failed to determine the winner and we needed to wait for extra time. Fernando Rapallini starts it right now!
90+6' The second half has just finished.
90+5' Carlos Soler (Spain) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+5' Dani Olmo (Spain) sends the free kick into the box, but Bono leaps to intercept it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Spain will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' It looks like Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) saw red with that tackle. Fernando Rapallini won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick to Spain.
90+3' Romain Saiss (Morocco) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+1' Carlos Soler swings in the free kick towards Alvaro Morata (Spain), who powers a header high over the bar from close in.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Romain Saiss (Morocco) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.

90' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Fernando Rapallini no option but to blow his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Spain.
89' Alvaro Morata (Spain) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
89' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Nico Williams (Spain) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
87' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Spain) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
84' Nayef Aguerd is being substituted because of an injury. Walid Regragui sends Jawad El Yamiq (Morocco) on the pitch.
83' The game is interrupted now, Nayef Aguerd (Morocco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) replaces Noussair Mazraoui.
82' Here is a change. Selim Amallah is going off and Walid Regragui gives the last tactical orders to Walid Cheddira (Morocco).
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Youssef En Nesyri will be replaced by Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco).
82' Good chance! Alvaro Morata (Spain) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
81' A quickly taken corner by Spain.

80' Marcos Llorente (Spain) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Spain have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Nico Williams (Spain) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
78' Dani Olmo (Spain) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
77' Fernando Rapallini shows the yellow card to Aymeric Laporte (Spain) for a heavy challenge.
75' Ferran Torres will be replaced by Nico Williams (Spain).
75' The Spain players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
73' Alvaro Morata (Spain) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
72' Romain Saiss (Morocco) plays a terrific long ball forward to Hakim Ziyech, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
70' The attendance is 44667.
69' Dani Olmo (Spain) sends a low pass from outside the box to Alvaro Morata. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
68' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Dani Olmo (Spain) takes it short.
68' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jordi Alba (Spain), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Spain.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sofiane Boufal departs the field of play to be replaced by Ez Abde (Morocco).
66' Ferran Torres (Spain) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
64' Jordi Alba (Spain) is able to continue to play.
63' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Gavi and he is replaced by Carlos Soler (Spain).
63' Substitution. Marco Asensio is replaced by Alvaro Morata (Spain).
63' Jordi Alba (Spain) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
62' Pedri (Spain) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
61' Fernando Rapallini has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nayef Aguerd (Morocco). Spain earn a free kick.
58' Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul after Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) hacks down one of his opponents.
56' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
55' Dani Olmo (Spain) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Bono to dive and make a save.
54' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul. Spain are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
51' Dangerous play by Achraf Hakimi (Morocco). Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Ferran Torres (Spain) is flagged for offside.
48' Marco Asensio (Spain) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
47' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Spain get a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Marco Asensio (Spain) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
45' Marco Asensio receives a short pass from Ferran Torres (Spain), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort. The ball goes out of play and Spain have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Great ball in from Sofiane Boufal. Nayef Aguerd (Morocco) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
42' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) whips in the resulting free kick but one of the defenders heads the ball to safety.
41' Gavi (Spain) makes a rough challenge and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul. Morocco are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
40' Gavi (Spain) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
39' Pedri (Spain) passes the ball onto Marco Asensio, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
36' Dani Olmo (Spain) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

33' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Unai Simon!
32' Rodri (Spain) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul.
30' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) heads on.
27' Marco Asensio (Spain) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Jordi Alba. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
25' Ferran Torres (Spain) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

22' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is behind the touchline and Morocco will take a throw-in.
21' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
19' Aymeric Laporte (Spain) sends a long ball forward to Jordi Alba, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
17' The linesman raises his flag. Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) is adjudged offside.
15' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.

13' Rodri (Spain) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Fernando Rapallini with no other option than to blow for a foul.
12' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
10' Gavi (Spain) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Fernando Rapallini blows for a foul. Morocco earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
9' Gavi (Spain) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sofiane Boufal (Morocco).
5' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
3' Decent spell from Spain here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The ball is out of play. Spain will take a throw-in.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Spain will have the kick-off.
Fernando Rapallini got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
